mapper.select: SELECT connection_key,sync_status status,watermark_updated_at watermark,requested_window_from requested_from,requested_window_to requested_to,requested_trigger,requested_by,last_attempt_at,last_success_at,next_run_at,last_batch_id,failure_count,last_error_code,last_error_detail FROM t_jira_sync_state WHERE connection_key=#{connectionKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_jira_sync_state SET source_instance_hash=#{instanceHash},sync_status=CASE WHEN sync_status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') THEN sync_status ELSE #{status} END,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE connection_key=#{connectionKey}

UPDATE t_jira_sync_state SET sync_status='QUEUED',requested_window_from=#{from},requested_window_to=#{to},requested_trigger=#{trigger},requested_by=#{actor},last_error_code=NULL,last_error_detail=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE connection_key=#{connectionKey} AND sync_status IN ('IDLE','FAILED')

UPDATE t_jira_sync_state SET sync_status='QUEUED',requested_window_from=NULL,requested_window_to=NULL,requested_trigger='SCHEDULED',requested_by=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE connection_key=#{connectionKey} AND sync_status IN ('IDLE','FAILED') AND (next_run_at IS NULL OR next_run_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))

UPDATE t_jira_sync_state SET sync_status='RUNNING',lease_holder=#{workerId},lease_expires_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 5 MINUTE),last_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE connection_key=#{connectionKey} AND (sync_status='QUEUED' OR (sync_status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)))

UPDATE t_jira_sync_state SET lease_expires_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 5 MINUTE),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE connection_key=#{connectionKey} AND sync_status='RUNNING' AND lease_holder=#{workerId}

UPDATE t_jira_sync_state SET sync_status='IDLE',watermark_updated_at=#{watermark},last_success_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),last_batch_id=#{batchDatabaseId},next_run_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL #{intervalMinutes} MINUTE),lease_holder=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,requested_window_from=NULL,requested_window_to=NULL,requested_trigger=NULL,requested_by=NULL,failure_count=0,last_error_code=NULL,last_error_detail=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE connection_key=#{connectionKey} AND sync_status='RUNNING' AND lease_holder=#{workerId}

UPDATE t_jira_sync_state SET sync_status='FAILED',failure_count=failure_count+1,next_run_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND),lease_holder=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{code},last_error_detail=#{detail},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE connection_key=#{connectionKey} AND sync_status='RUNNING' AND lease_holder=#{workerId}
